title: Love (1971) (Hungarian Revolution Special Screening)

title_lang.zh_hk: 愛（1971）（匈牙利革命紀念放映）

synopsis: In 1950s Hungary, János is imprisoned on political charges. Unable to tell his bedridden mother the truth, his wife Luca forges cheerful letters claiming he is directing films in America. Stripped of her teaching job, Luca quietly sells their belongings to sustain their lives under political isolation. Using black-and-white cinematography and stream-of-consciousness editing, Hungarian New Wave master Károly Makk depicts love and endurance under totalitarian rule. Winner of the 1971 Cannes Jury Prize, it is hailed as a cinematic masterpiece.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 五十年代匈牙利高壓統治下，Luca 的丈夫 János 因政治罪名鋃鐺入獄。面對臥病在床的婆婆，Luca 始終無法吐露真相，只好以丈夫之名捏造一封封歡快家書，謊稱 János 赴美拍片，讓老人在病榻上抱持希望。婆婆房間彷如孤島，只容往昔美好；房外的Luca卻時刻受現實重重碾壓。匈牙利新浪潮代表人物Károly Makk以黑白攝影與意識流的剪接，道盡極權下的愛與堅忍。本片獲1971年康城影展評審團獎，譽為匈牙利電影史上最動人傑作之一。
